messages:
Maria: Quick sync — need to lock a deployment review with Saffron Health for their Private (VPC) rollout. Couple preflight items to cover. Proposed slots: Wed 2026-04-02 10:00 PT, Wed 16:00 PT, Thu 09:00 PT. Who from infra/platform can join? I'll invite Saffron SRE and CS.
Kevin: Wed 10 PT works for me. Will prep network diagram + VPN details.
Anya: Saffron confirmed Tue/Thu are tough. They prefer Wed. I'll put them on Wed 10 and add SRE + PM.
Raj: Wed 10 ok but I have a hard conflict first 15m. Proposed agenda and timebox: 45m total — 1) VPC peering & routes (10m), 2) KMS & certs (7m), 3) capacity & autoscale expectations (8m), 4) rollback & fallback model (7m), 5) smoke tests & next steps (13m).
Liam: Quick preflight note — ran staging smoke, saw egress to blob store blocked from node pool. Snippet: ```kubectl get pods -n saffron -o wide``` shows Pending -> CrashLoopBackOff on uploader. Might be NAT/GW.
Kevin: Thanks — I'll bring the VPN/IPSec config and check routing tables. Can someone confirm whether we expect a managed NAT gateway or customer-provided?
Anya: Saffron says they'll provide NAT. I'll get CIDR blocks and contact details (Ali).
saffron-sre: Ali (Saffron SRE) here — confirmed NAT + transit gateway. Will share peering CIDRs by EOD Tue. Can we verify Firewall rules: allow 4500/udp for IPSEC + 443 outbound to our artifact buckets?
Raj: Noted. Also flag: internal runbook requires ephemeral ports for KV cache warmup. Add to agenda.
Maria: OK locking Wed 10 PT. I've created a calendar event and invited: Eng-Infra, Eng-Platform, Solutions, CS, and Saffron SRE. Prep asks: paste any blocking preflight findings here by EOD Tue so we can triage before the call.
deploy-bot: calendar created: https://calendar.redwood.internal/event/abcd1234 (Wed 2026-04-02 10:00 PT)
Raj: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/saffron-private-preflight — note: ensure port 4500/udp open for IPSEC and 1024-65535 ephemeral for peering tests.
Anya: Added Saffron contact @Ali (saffron-sre) and PM Jordan to the invite.
Kevin: I'll upload the network diag + expected throughput numbers to the event doc.
Liam: I'll follow up with the staging pod logs and NAT test output here by EOD.
Maria: Great — agenda locked. See you Wed. :thumbsup:
